text:
Maya (CSM): Morning team — kicking off Saffron onboarding. Quick sync to align stakeholders, success criteria, and a 30/60/90 timeline. Can folks confirm owners for integration, enablement, and what we need for staging access? Proposing Thu 10am PT for a 30-min kickoff call. @Rohit @Sam

Rohit (Integration Lead): I'm the tech lead for this integration. We'll own the API hookup and monitoring. Need staging API keys, sample dataset (500 rows), and SSO plan. Thu 10am works.

Sam (Solutions Eng): I'll own the demos, enablement, and the initial prompt tuning. Can we get staging access by EOD Fri? I'll prep a runbook and two demo flows.

Evelyn (Saffron PM): Thanks everyone. Our success criteria: 1) 10k/month queries with <200ms p95 for core search flow; 2) SSO for org admins; 3) Data retention 90d and audit logs. Renewal review scheduled in ~60 days — that's a risk if we don't hit early milestones.

Maya (CSM): Noted success criteria and renewal timing. I'll add these to the onboarding playbook. Any compliance blockers?

Rohit (Integration Lead): We need copy of SOC2 and KMS/HSM details for the Private option. If those aren't available, suggest Dedicated as fallback. Also will need a service account with the proper scopes.

Sam (Solutions Eng): For demos I'll build two playbooks: 'Search Assist' and 'Support Triage' and a small prompt eval set. Deliverables: demo decks + lab env by next Tue.

Onboarding Bot: Created ticket ORG-559 and checklist here: https://redwood.example/orga/559/checklist :white_check_mark:

Maya (CSM): I've added 30/60/90 milestones to the playbook:
- 30d: basic integration + smoke tests, staging validations
- 60d: enablement for ops + prompt A/B tests, baseline SLOs
- 90d: go-live, SLA review, and renewal prep

Evelyn (Saffron PM): Request: weekly 30-min demos for first 6 weeks + biweekly NPS pulses. Also need training for 6 ops members (2 admins, 4 agents).

Maya (CSM): Will schedule the weekly demos and a 2-hour enablement session in week 3. @Sam can you own training materials and labs?

Sam (Solutions Eng): Yep — I'll create the training deck, hands-on lab, and a short quiz. Also setting up an eval prompt suite to monitor quality drift.

Rohit (Integration Lead): Timeline OK from my side. Staging creds by Friday are critical — I'll ping infra. Quick command we'll use to test token generation:

```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/orgs/saffron/keys \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"env":"staging"}'
```

Maya (CSM): Owners recap: Integration = Rohit; Solutions/Training = Sam; Success Ops = Maya; Customer PM = Evelyn. I'll follow up with calendar invites and a shared Confluence playbook.

Evelyn (Saffron PM): Sounds good. Also logging feature asks into your backlog — prefer we track FRs separately so procurement sees them.

Maya (CSM): Logged feature request CR-102 in the backlog and linked it on the playbook.

Sam (Solutions Eng): :thumbsup:

Rohit (Integration Lead): I'll post when staging creds are available. If infra delays, we may shift the first demo by a day.

Maya (CSM): Thanks everyone — next action: I'll send invites and link to the playbook. If anything else pops up, drop it here or DM me.
